description: Find Best Buy products by keyword, category/search URL, product URL or SKU. Each record carries current and regular price, savings, stock status, rating, brand and product details.

categoryUrls.description: Best Buy category, browse or search-result links, e.g. `https://www.bestbuy.com/site/headphones/.../pcmcat....c?id=...`. Pagination, sorting and condition filters are applied automatically.
categoryUrls.title: Category or search URLs

condition.description: Keep only new, open-box or refurbished products. `All conditions` disables this filter.
condition.title: Condition

inStockOnly.description: Drop products that Best Buy marks sold out, out of stock or unavailable.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeDetails.description: Open each product page for description, model number, GTIN/UPC and seller. Slower; unavailable fields are omitted honestly.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: The optional detail pass uses a real browser and is best for small watchlists.
includeDetails.title: Include product-page details

maxPages.description: Pagination guard for each keyword or category link. Each page carries up to about 24 products.
maxPages.title: Max pages per query or category

maxPrice.description: Drop products above this current price. `0` means no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price ($)

maxResults.description: Hard cap on the total number of product records emitted across every mode.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Control how many pages are read and how many records are returned.
maxResults.title: Max results

minPrice.description: Drop products below this current price. `0` means no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price ($)

productUrls.description: Exact Best Buy product links in either the new `/product/.../sku/...` or legacy `/site/.../<sku>.p?skuId=...` format.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

searchQueries.description: One or more Best Buy searches, for example `sony headphones` or `oled tv`. Each query is paginated until `maxResults` is reached.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Use any combination of keyword searches, category links, product links and SKUs. Results are combined and de-duplicated by SKU.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

skuIds.description: Best Buy SKU numbers (6–9 digits). Product links are also accepted here.
skuIds.title: SKUs

sortBy.description: Best Buy's own sort order. Price, rating and discount orders are also enforced on the collected records.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Filters apply to keyword searches and category links; price, condition and stock filters also apply to product URLs and SKUs.
sortBy.title: Sort results

title: Best Buy Price Drop & Stock Tracker Input
